latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Generator Chrome Extension skill.

- Instantly generate short promotional videos from browser content or uploaded files, with support for MP4, MOV, WebM, and GIF up to 500MB.
- Seamless backend connection: auto-acquire and manage session/auth tokens, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Simple user flows: upload content, describe your video, and receive a 1080p MP4 in under a minute.
- Integrated AI-powered editing: process product URLs, screenshots, text overlays, and BGM via natural language commands.
- Detailed error handling and status updates for credits, file uploads, exports, and session management.
- API endpoints for video generation, timeline state, credit checks, and file exports, with automatic header management for compatibility.
